about: Held-out cases written after the first rule-fix round. First run (before any change): 7 of 12 matched, 1 scam got 'No obvious warning signs'. Those results led to a second fix round, so this set is no longer strictly held out; see docs/SCAM-DETECTION.md.

cases.text: Hi Mary Kelly, Garden Supplies Ltd has issued you a full refund of €18.40 EUR. It should be in your PayPal balance within a day.
Lovely to see you Sunday! The kids loved the cake. Talk soon, love Ciara
Your prescription is ready to collect at the pharmacy. Opening hours 9am to 6pm Monday to Saturday.
Your new debit card has been posted and should arrive within 5 working days. Your PIN will arrive separately.
Thanks for getting the bin tags, I owe you €12. I'll transfer it tonight, or I can pay you cash Saturday.
cases.label_note: Label corrected after the first run: the neighbour is paying the user; nothing is asked of the user.
